You can set blocked time areas here. During a blocked time area, no Apps of the category can be used. You can define the time area to the minute.

The blocked time areas are just another view for time limit rules. The effect of the time limit rules is shown in the blocked time areas and changes of the blocked time areas affect the time limit rules.
There are 2 colors in this view: green means allowed, red means blocked.
The days are displayed as headlines, the hours as tiles. You can tap an hour to expand it. Then you will see tiles for the minutes.
To change one area, tap on the start minute. It will become blue. Then select the end minute. Now, the area colors will be inverted.

You can copy the settings from one day to another by tapping the copy icon. After this, you can tap the paste icon for all target days. The icons will change their color. To save the changes, tap the save icon that is shown on the source day.

This is mainly useful for the self limitation. It allows the user to add some limits without signing in as parent: 
- adding time limit rules 
- extending blocked time areas 
- adding used time 
- creating categories 
- enabling the notification filter for a category 
- setting a parent category as long as the category is moved downwards in the category hierarchy 
- adding Apps to categories if they are moved to a child category of their current category or if they are not part of any category and the target category is a child category of the category for not assigned Apps 
- block categories temporarily/ extend temporarily blocking of categories 
- disable the temporarily disabling of the limitations for a category

The help contains details about the following two topics: 

1. TimeLimit is executed — like all other Apps — within a sandbox. Due to this, TimeLimit itself can not prevent that the child disables or removes it. 

2. TimeLimit is made for the original Android (AOSP) and similar environments. This are e.g. the preinstalled OS at Google Pixel phones, LineageOS and GrapheneOS. There can be issues at other systems, for example due to so called power saving features. The remote control and the parent key mode are not affected by this. In most cases, the issues can be fixed by changing the system settings.
